turns.user: We already have a receptionist. Why would we add this?
turns.reply:
A receptionist handles your phone well. This covers your website. When a visitor shows up after hours, during lunch, or while your receptionist is on another call, they get answers from the services, hours and prices you've approved. They can also leave a visit or callback request. Your team then picks up from the saved conversation instead of starting over. It adds to what your receptionist does.

When do customers most often wait or slip through the cracks right now?

turns.user: Would she get her own account and have customer requests automatically assigned to her?
turns.reply:
**No to both, as things stand.** We don't currently offer separate staff logins or automatic assignment of requests to a team member.

Website requests and conversations are saved in your owner portal. From there, someone has to review each request and confirm the next step. The customer's details and the full conversation are all in one place, so whoever follows up doesn't start from scratch. Still, getting a request to your receptionist would be up to you.

If she needs her own login and automatic assignment, we don't offer that now.
